title: A1 Reading Comprehension — PKE Style
description: Short Polish text followed by multiple-choice comprehension questions, matching the A1 PKE reading section format.

passage.title: Moja rodzina
passage.text: Nazywam się Marek Nowak. Jestem z Krakowa. Mam trzydzieści lat. Jestem nauczycielem. Moja żona nazywa się Ewa. Ona jest lekarką. Mamy dwoje dzieci — syna i córkę. Syn ma pięć lat, a córka ma osiem lat. Mieszkamy w dużym mieszkaniu w centrum Krakowa. Bardzo lubimy Kraków. To piękne miasto.
passage.translation: My name is Marek Nowak. I am from Kraków. I am thirty years old. I am a teacher. My wife's name is Ewa. She is a doctor. We have two children — a son and a daughter. The son is five years old and the daughter is eight years old. We live in a large apartment in the centre of Kraków. We love Kraków very much. It is a beautiful city.

exercises.explanation: The text says 'Jestem nauczycielem' — I am a teacher.
The text says 'Jestem z Krakowa' — I am from Kraków.
The text says 'Ona jest lekarką' — She is a doctor. 'Lekarka' is the feminine form of 'lekarz' (doctor).
The text says 'córka ma osiem lat' — the daughter is eight years old. 'Osiem' = eight.
The text says 'To piękne miasto' — It is a beautiful city. 'Piękne' = beautiful (neuter form).

exercises.prompt: According to the text, how many children does Marek have? Answer in Polish digits.
exercises.explanation: The text says 'Mamy dwoje dzieci' — We have two children. 'Dwoje' is the neuter collective numeral used with 'dzieci' (children).

exercises.prompt: Where do Marek and Ewa live?
options: in a large apartment in the city centre
in a small house outside the city
exercises.explanation: The text says 'Mieszkamy w dużym mieszkaniu w centrum Krakowa' — We live in a large apartment in the centre of Kraków.
